title: David O. Miller
description: "l like the serious mythological themes in STAR WARS," says David O. Miller, "but I also love the humor, especially the Worrt (the road creature from RETURN OF THE JEDI). He sees, he eats, he belches." In 1990, Miller began work as a freelance illustrator after leaving his job as Art Director for the U.S. Space Camp/NASA Visitor Center in Huntsville, Alabama. Now set up with a studio in New York, Miller has contributed to DUNGEONS AND DRAGONS magazine, SPELLJAMMER, BUCK ROGERS and DARK SUN for TSR, ARS MAGICA and VAMPIRE for White Wolf and CHALLENGE magazine and MYTHUS for GDW.
